data.name: Bramble Guard
data.detailed_description:
Spend your daylight exploring branching roads, lifting fog, claiming mines, opening gates, finding shrines, and deciding which trouble deserves today's supplies. What you discover on the map changes what you can build, upgrade, defend, and risk next.

Bramble Guard is a fantasy strategy-defense game about dangerous maps to uncover, castles to manage, and tactical encounters where towers are only the beginning.

A TOWER IS NOT A TURRET

Towers in Bramble Guard are not just weapons on sticks. They are places defenders come from.

Knights step into the lane and physically hold enemies in place. Archers punish the wave from behind. Spearmen buy breathing room before pressure breaks the line. Monks keep the wounded standing long enough for the next decision to matter.

  • Place towers to control space, not only to deal damage.

  • Send real defenders into visible lanes.

  • Watch the front line shift as units block, fall back, recover, and return.

MAPS, CASTLES, AND BAD JUDGEMENT


Before and between encounters, you guide heroes and the forces bound to them through dangerous maps full of roads, fog, mines, castles, shrines, treasures, blocked paths, and decisions that would look wiser from a safe distance.

Those maps are not just paths between fights. They belong to a wider fantasy world of different castles, races, factions, forest peoples, broken orders, old borders, and places that remember who failed them.

Castles and claimed sites are not decoration. They are part of the strategy layer: places to strengthen, routes to open, resources to secure, and positions to hold while the world gets less polite around you.

Armies do not wander politely on their own. They move with heroes, follow them into danger, and appear on the field when a hero is there to lead them.

Across the road, you discover who still lives here, who wants the ruins back, and what the corruption has made out of everyone else.

  • Explore multiple campaign maps instead of one fixed board.
  • Move heroes and their bound forces through the world instead of selecting battles from a menu.
  • Travel through regions shaped by distinct castles, races, factions, and old powers.
  • Claim mines and sites to support future expeditions.
  • Manage castles, gates, routes, and upgrades between fights.
  • Meet factions, guardians, settlements, and enemies through encounters and story moments.
  • Spend limited movement carefully: the road always wants more than you brought.

WHEN THE ROAD ARGUES BACK

Encounters are not always the same kind of fight. Bramble Guard uses tower-defense battles, inverted defense scenarios, and more direct tactical clashes to keep the road from becoming predictable.

Sometimes you are holding a lane. Sometimes pressure comes from the wrong direction. Sometimes the answer is not another tower, but the right hero, formation, ability, or upgrade at the right moment.

  • Fight active 3D tower-defense battles with physical defenders.

  • Face encounter variants beyond standard tower defense.

  • Use heroes, abilities, formations, upgrades, and battle gold to survive changing pressure.

BRING SOMETHING HOME

Victory does not vanish when the encounter ends. Salvage, claimed sites, opened roads, castle progress, hero growth, discoveries, achievements, and upgrades change what the next map allows.

A good expedition makes the next expedition less doomed. Slightly.

  • Bring resources back from encounters.

  • Open new routes and strengthen important positions.

  • Build toward better defenses, stronger heroes, and safer roads.

A SAD STORYBOOK FANTASY

There were ten Trees of Memory, once. Nine burned. One remains.

The Heartwood is the last living Tree of Memory and the final refuge of an ancient order. The corruption spreading from its roots was born from grief, not simple evil. Bramble Guard begins bright and readable, then lets sorrow creep into the color one thorn at a time.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fantasy strategy-defense across multiple dangerous maps.

  • A map-and-castle layer with roads, fog, mines, shrines, gates, resources, and upgrades.

  • Active 3D tower-defense encounters where towers send real defenders into the lane.

  • Encounter variety beyond standard tower defense, including inverted and direct tactical fights.

  • Knights, archers, spearmen, monks, heroes, abilities, formations, and battle upgrades.

  • Persistent progress through salvage, claimed sites, opened routes, castle development, hero growth, discoveries, achievements, and upgrades.

  • A mournful storybook world told through beautiful fantasy, tired wisdom, and one deeply interrupting king.

STORE SUPPORT

  • Steam Deck Verified.

  • Full controller support.

  • Menus and subtitles in 10 languages.

  • English voice-over only.

data.short_description: Hybrid fantasy strategy defense, as explained by a tired elder and interrupted by a beautiful fool in a crown. Build a fragile refuge, send defenders into the road, and protect the last Tree of Memory.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10x64 / Windows 11x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-14400F (or equivalent)
  • Graphics: RTX 3050 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700KF (or equivalent)
  • Graphics: RTX 5070 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
